name: berm
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Game bitmap background cutout for a hand-painted gothic Halloween 2D SIDE SCROLLING platformer. Create ONE extra wide 3:1 parallax layer, 3072 by 1024 if possible. A modest country berm with rolling dark earthy soil, low mossy stone walls and scattered autumn bushes, a few small crooked bare orchard trees, low orange pumpkins. View horizontally from the side at pedestrian height; no top down. The visual silhouette sits around 35 percent from the top, irregular foliage and stones rise into the transparent upper region. CRITICAL: there is absolutely NO sky, NO purple bands, NO mountain or landscape painted behind trees, no buildings, no mist, no transparency anywhere below the rolling soil horizon. The entire lower half is continuous opaque textured charcoal brown earth and small gravel ALL THE WAY TO ALL THREE lower edges. This is solid land with a transparent space above its irregular top edge, NOT floating clumps. Left and right edges match at the same ground elevation for horizontal tiling. All bottom pixels opaque. Muted blue gray night lighting with restrained warm fallen leaves, hand-painted detailed storybook videogame style, moderate black contours. No characters, words, frame, borders or ground shadow fading into transparency.

name: gate
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference image ONLY establishes oblique perspective and hand painted materials. Create a NEW Halloween village entrance as an isolated transparent game scenery cutout, wide 1536x1024. CRITICAL SIDE-VIEW OBLIQUE GATE for a left-to-right platformer. The gateway plane recedes sharply diagonally from a large NEAR stone pillar at lower LEFT to a small FAR pillar high on the RIGHT. Near pillar foot around (480,965), far pillar foot (1130,650). Near pillar height 880, far pillar height 460. Strong perspective foreshortening, NOT a frontal symmetrical arch, NOT a decorative sign facing the viewer across a street. Player travels LEFT TO RIGHT through the space between posts. Weathered stone posts, modest peaked slate caps, open wooden/iron gate leaves angled away along the depth direction, small warm lanterns, discreet autumn ivy. A small unlettered hanging wooden plaque on the far side of the near pillar, oriented in perspective. A few pumpkins at bases. NO sky, landscape, floor slab, ground plane, fog, text, people or backdrop. Everything between posts and all surrounding image must be actually transparent. Entire object contained with margins. Rich muted charcoal, blue slate and brown, restrained warm lamps, detailed painterly game illustration matching reference. No front-facing signboard suspended horizontally between equal pillars.

name: witch-absorb
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an animation sprite sheet for the SAME green witch as the reference: hooked nose, wild white hair, purple pointed hat with gold buckle, purple coat, brown boots, expressive mischievous eyes, chunky polished hand-painted cartoon videogame sprite. Transparent background. EXACTLY 4 columns x 6 rows = 24 separate frames, regular equal cells with ample empty gutters, no borders/numbers/text. Always facing LEFT, same body proportions and stable pelvis/foot registration throughout, do not trim or merge frames. Animation: absorbing a transformed villager's candy into a carved orange jack-o-lantern then magically releasing that pumpkin into the air. ROWS 1-3 (12 frames): witch STANDING, no broom. Frames 0-3: reaches under cloak, pulls out pumpkin, lifts lid, prepares greedy inhaling spell. Frames 4-7: winds arm, ribbons of purple mint light spiral from LEFT into pumpkin, cheeks puff then delighted expression, candy vanishes inside. Frames 8-11: pumpkin glows cyan/purple inside, witch lifts and releases it to left and upwards, hands follow through, then returns to ready stance. ROWS 4-6 repeat the same 12 action stages but witch seated on broom, both feet drawn, broom consistently facing LEFT. The released pumpkin appears only close beside hands; no miniature witch inside it. Crisp readable silhouettes and distinct intermediate poses, changing arms/head/coat. Glows small and contained within each cell. No scenery, no cast shadow on floor, no gore. Keep the exact character identity and illustration style in reference.

name: witch-cast
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ANIMATION SHEET for the exact green witch in the reference, same purple buckle hat, white hair, long nose, purple coat and boots, same hand-painted cartoon game style. EXACTLY 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 frames, transparent background, large clear gutters, no background aura filling cells. Every character faces LEFT. Fixed character scale and fixed feet/broom anchor per sequence, entire character inside each cell. Top TWO rows: eight consecutive frames of a STANDING witch casting. 0 raises short wand in anticipation, 1 coils shoulder, 2 little violet charge at wand tip, 3 swings wand DOWN toward left, 4 releases bright small jagged violet flash from wand tip held straight left at chest height, 5 follows through at SAME TIP location, 6 recovers with fading sparks, 7 settles into stance. Bottom TWO rows: same eight frames seated on horizontal broom facing left, wand at forward hand pointing LEFT AND DOWN when releasing. Important distinct arm, shoulder, coat and expression progression, no pose duplication. Body does NOT morph or change costume. No long beam baked into sprite: only contained flash and sparks from the WAND TIP. No ray from mouth or eyes. No text, grid, numbers, ground, shadows, rectangles, or huge diffuse glow. Maintain the recognizable witch identity from reference.

name: soul-pumpkin
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A polished hand-painted cartoon Halloween game SPRITE SHEET, exactly 4 columns x 6 rows = 24 separate equal grid cells, transparent background, clear empty gutters, no text or borders. Subject: one small enchanted FLYING jack-o-lantern with orange carved shell, crooked stem, mischievous triangular violet eyes, cyan/purple ghost fire inside, two tiny ghostly flame fins at sides, tapering blue violet wisp under it. Clearly a pumpkin creature, not a witch or person. Every pose faces LEFT in 3/4 view, same size, same identity. Row 1 frames 0-3 hovering loop with fins/wisp waving and squash stretch. Row 2 frames 4-7 charging to spit a magical ghost-fire ball, cheeks/shell expanding, inner face brighter. Row 3 frames 8-11 shoots a short blue violet flame ball LEFT, recoils, mouth closes; projectile flash close to mouth only. Row 4 frames 12-15 defeat: dim eyes, crack appears, pumpkin tumbles downward, lands on its SIDE, no blood. Row 5 frames 16-19: shell settles and splits apart into two orange halves, a bright wrapped candy appears between them with violet sparks. Row 6 frames 20-23: candy unwraps into a small rising warm human-shaped light silhouette, empty cracked pumpkin halves settle, glow dissipates. Keep fragments in cell, full object visible with margins. No opaque backdrop, no scenery, no text, no skulls, no gore. Purple/cyan magic contrasts with orange shell. Finely painted shading and readable dark contours in same game-art aesthetic as referenced witch/pumpkin.

name: country-road
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a wide 3:1 painted ground tile for a side scrolling Halloween game. Reference is for soil and cobble colors ONLY. This is a COUNTRY WALKING SURFACE seen at the low oblique angle of a 2D side scroller. Ground fills the ENTIRE image except a thin irregular transparent outline along the TOP 5 percent: tiny tufts of dry olive grass, small roots, autumn leaves and pebbles define this natural top edge. From 8 percent image height ALL pixels are solid opaque textured ground through the bottom. No horizon, no sky, no mountains, no bushes or tall objects, no stairs or ledge, no floating island, no painted rectangular border. Muted charcoal brown and dusty gray soil, worn scattered irregular flat paving stones, restrained green moss, ochre leaves. Shallow perspective: smaller stones at upper edge, larger close stones lower, consistent with reference. Left and right edges tile seamlessly, upper edge same average height on both. Important: no hard straight horizontal top seam, no ground fading or translucent patches. No people, props, wording, vignette. Detailed hand painted game background, readable low contrast earth.

name: resistance
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Cartoon hand-painted animation sprite sheet for two EXISTING adult male villagers in references. EXACTLY 4 columns x 6 rows, 24 individual equal cells, large transparent gutters, transparent background, no grid/no labels. Reference 1: stocky moustached baker, brown cap, cream shirt/apron, blue waistcoat, brown boots. Reference 2: muscular bearded blacksmith with curly dark hair, rust-red shirt, tan leather apron, gray trousers and gloves. Same identities/proportions/colors as references. ROWS 1-2 (8 frames): baker has put away basket, steps backward LEFT while facing RIGHT, picks a small gray stone from pouch, winds throwing arm, throws stone RIGHT, follows through, glances LEFT toward escape, retreats two steps. Clear consecutive poses; stone only in hand before release. ROWS 3-4 (8 frames): blacksmith repeats the same eight stages, throws a stone RIGHT while retreating LEFT, courage mixed with alarm. ROW 5 (4 frames): baker sitting awkwardly trapped, one leg beneath a loose beam, distressed reaches up, pushes with arms, begins standing; no injuries or gore. Keep wood small; full body visible and identifiable. ROW 6 (4 isolated scenery frames, NO person): a small pile of fallen timber and loose masonry, then cracks/dislodges, then timbers falling apart, finally low scattered rubble. These rubble props will overlay the trapped baker's lower body. Muted cottage era clothes, no modern police uniform, no weapons beyond small stones, no blood, no text, no ground background. Paint proper leg/arm articulation, no duplicates.

name: soul-effects
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Animated magic effects sprite atlas for a hand-painted anime cartoon Halloween platform game. Looks like a fiery enchanted ball, not a laser line, not a ghost character. Same center/scale in each frame, changing hand-painted contours; contained luminous edge only. Third row 4 frames: compact violet-blue impact puff, spark bloom, dispersing sparks, final fading sparks, all centered. Bottom row 4 frames: a SINGLE small gray thrown stone rotating with four distinct orientations, sharp hand-painted brown-gray pebble shading, NO glow, no motion trail. Whole objects contained with at least 15 percent transparent margin. Colorful expressive cartoon game art with dark contour, textured painting and bright white highlights. No characters, no labels, no text, no grid, no scenery, no circles or SVG-looking uniform geometry.
